{{Quote|Instruct the others to hold back. We'll pace the target and stay close. We'll signal when we want the others to close. Tell Shieldbreaker to stand by to pick up prisoners. And tell our boarding shuttle to stand by to launch.|Voyce Evlen|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''''Shieldbreaker''''' was a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> it was under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Voyce Evlen]] during a brief skirmish with the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] vessel ''[[Concussor]]'', which was secretly commandeered by Galactic Alliance [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit [[Wraith Squadron]].<ref name="MK" />
